index.title: AliSearch – See the real price of every AliExpress variant
index.description: Free Chrome extension for AliExpress: shows every product variant with its real price right in the search results, sorted from cheapest. Spot bait prices at a glance.
index.og_title: AliSearch – See the real price of every AliExpress variant
index.og_description: Free Chrome extension for AliExpress: shows every product variant with its real price right in the search results, sorted from cheapest. Spot bait prices at a glance.
index.jsonld_description: Chrome extension that shows every AliExpress product variant with its real price in the search results, sorted from cheapest.
index.h1: See the real price of every AliExpress variant
index.lead: The price in AliExpress search results is often just the cheapest variant – a 10 cm cable, a single piece, an accessory. AliSearch shows every variant with its real price, right in the search results, sorted from cheapest.
index.hero_alt: A $0.29 cable variant that is only 10 cm long, next to the real variants at $1.89, $2.49 and $2.99
index.what_li1: Expands product variants (color, size, length, quantity…) directly in the search results
index.what_li2: Shows the real price of every variant
index.what_li3: Sorts all products and variants by price across the whole page
index.what_li4: Marks out-of-stock variants and bundle offers – show or hide them with one click
index.what_li5: “Show Original” switches back to the normal AliExpress view at any time
index.affiliate_p: AliSearch uses affiliate links. When you open a product through AliSearch and buy it, we may earn a small commission from AliExpress, at no extra cost to you. Affiliate links never change prices and do not affect which products are shown or how they are sorted.
index.disclaimer: AliSearch is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by AliExpress or Alibaba Group.

support.title: AliSearch support – help and FAQ
support.description: Help for the AliSearch Chrome extension: where it works, why tabs open in the background, CAPTCHA, settings, and how to report a problem.
support.og_description: Help for the AliSearch Chrome extension: where it works, why tabs open in the background, CAPTCHA, settings, and how to report a problem.
support.lead: Something not working, or a question? Check the answers below, or write to {email}. We answer support e-mail in English.
support.a_where: On AliExpress search result pages (aliexpress.com and aliexpress.us, including regional versions). The AliSearch bar appears above the results. It does not run on other websites.
support.q_tabs: Why do tabs open in the background?
support.a_tabs: Variant prices are only listed on each product's own page. AliSearch opens the product pages in background tabs, reads the variant names and prices, and closes the tabs again. It only reads the pages; it does not change anything.
support.q_captcha: AliExpress asks me for a security check (CAPTCHA)
support.a_captcha: When AliSearch opens many product pages quickly, AliExpress sometimes asks for a security check. AliSearch brings that page to the front so you can complete it. If it keeps happening, lower the number of parallel extractions in the settings.
support.q_slow: Expanding is slow, or my browser feels slow
support.a_slow: Open the settings (gear icon in the AliSearch bar). You can choose how many products are expanded automatically (5, 10, 20, 50 or all) and how many are processed at the same time.
support.q_original: How do I get the normal AliExpress view back?
support.a_original: Click {show_original} in the AliSearch bar. Click it again to switch back.
support.q_borders: What are the blue and brown borders?
support.a_borders: Light blue marks out-of-stock variants, brown marks bundle offers. You can show or hide both with the switches in the bar.
support.a_prices: No. It shows the prices that AliExpress lists for each variant. AliSearch uses affiliate links, which never change the price you pay.
support.report_p: Use the pencil icon in the AliSearch bar, or e-mail {email}. Please include:
support.report_li1: the address of the search page (or what you searched for),
support.report_li4: what you expected and what happened – a screenshot helps a lot.

privacy.title: AliSearch privacy policy
privacy.description: What data the AliSearch Chrome extension handles, why, and for how long. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
privacy.og_description: What data the AliSearch Chrome extension handles, why, and for how long. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
privacy.authoritative_note: This is a translation for convenience. The English version is authoritative if there is any difference.
privacy.short: In short: AliSearch has no ads, no analytics and no tracking. It works on AliExpress search pages only. Data leaves your browser in three cases: when you open a product through AliSearch (to create the affiliate link), when you choose to send us feedback, and – only if you submit it – when you answer the optional uninstall survey.
privacy.who_p: AliSearch is developed and operated by an individual developer in the European Union. Contact for any privacy question: {email}.
privacy.stays_li1: Settings (how many products to expand, parallel extractions, show/hide out-of-stock and bundle items) are stored with Chrome's storage. If you use Chrome sync, Google syncs them between your devices.
privacy.stays_li2: Affiliate link cache: links already created for products, so they are not requested again.
privacy.stays_li3: Page content: AliSearch reads AliExpress search and product pages to find variants and prices. This happens in your browser; the page content is not sent to us.
privacy.row1_when: You open a product through AliSearch
privacy.row1_what: The AliExpress product address, the time, and the country of your request (derived from your IP address by Cloudflare; we do not store the IP address)
privacy.row1_why: To create the affiliate link and redirect you to the product; to detect errors and abuse
privacy.row2_what: Your message, the address of the page you were on, your browser version (user agent), the AliSearch version, and – only if you enter them – your name and e-mail address
privacy.row2_why: To answer you and fix problems
privacy.row2_how_long: As long as needed to handle your message; deleted on request
privacy.row3_when: You submit the optional uninstall survey
privacy.row3_what: The reason you selected, any free-text note you add, your browser version (user agent), and – if present in the page address – the AliSearch version. The uninstall page address may include only the language and that version; it does not include a user ID.
privacy.row3_why: To understand why people remove the extension and improve it
privacy.row3_how_long: As long as needed to review the answers; deleted on request
privacy.receive_p: We do not sell your data, do not use it for advertising, and do not use it for any purpose other than the ones above.
privacy.uninstall_version_note: When you remove AliSearch, Chrome may open the uninstall survey with a version query parameter (for example ?version=1.1.0) so we know which release you used. That parameter is not a personal identifier.
privacy.providers_li1: Cloudflare runs our server (Cloudflare Workers) and database (Cloudflare D1).
privacy.providers_li2: AliExpress Affiliate API receives the product address to create the affiliate link. After the redirect you are on AliExpress, and the AliExpress privacy policy applies – AliExpress may set cookies to attribute the purchase.
privacy.providers_li3: Resend delivers feedback and uninstall-survey messages to our mailbox (Google Gmail).
privacy.affiliate_p: AliSearch uses affiliate links. When you open a product through AliSearch and buy it, we may earn a small commission from AliExpress, at no extra cost to you. Affiliate links never change prices and do not affect which products are shown or how they are sorted.
privacy.legal_li1: Product redirects: our legitimate interest in providing the feature you use and keeping the service working (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.legal_li2: Feedback: your consent, given by sending the message (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw it at any time.
privacy.legal_li3: Uninstall survey: your consent, given by submitting the form (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). The survey is optional.
privacy.rights_p: You can ask for access to, correction or deletion of your data, restrict or object to its processing, or ask for a copy. Write to {email}. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.
privacy.children_p: AliSearch is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data.
privacy.changes_p: If we change how AliSearch handles data, we update this page and the “Last updated” date above.
